detailed_descriptions.en: If you're looking for more Words, more Cursed Items, and more Michael, this is the DLC for you! You'll find all of the below in one humongous DLC: 11 new characters to play as, each with their own unique pins and mechanics; 5 new challenges to test your skills; 100s of new items to add to the chaos; A brand new build-your-own challenge mode, for those who want to take things even further!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
If you're looking for more Words, more Cursed Items, and more Michael, this is the DLC for you! You'll find all of the below in one humongous DLC:

  • 11 new characters to play as, each with their own unique pins and mechanics;

  • 5 new challenges to test your skills;

  • 100s of new items to add to the chaos;

  • A brand new build-your-own challenge mode, for those who want to take things even further!
